en_US.title: Capsule Blackbox Audio 01
en_US.scanner: Blackbox fragment confirms ascent sleeve spent during survival burn.
en_US.field_note: Short audio: crush-frame, avionics flood, recovery ring shear, buoy unreliable, no narrator explanation.
en_US.terminal: BLACKBOX: survival burn complete. Ascent sleeve unavailable. Recovery ring no-lock.
en_US.audio: Burn spent. Ring no-lock. Do not request ascent.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Capsule Blackbox Audio 01 is the first playable proof that escape is blocked by named hardware failure.
en_US.external_site: The opening capsule audio gives HECTON-8 its hard-sci-fi lock: survival was purchased with the part that would have taken the player home.
